name: Beat my time
summary: A stop-at-10.00 stopwatch dare that goes blind at 3 seconds, with a head-to-head ladder you climb by beating a friend's time.
useWhen: someone dares the chat to beat their score: 'beat my 9.87', 'bet you can't'
a running head-to-head ladder between friends
dontUseWhen: a full arcade game starring the chat (use inside-joke-game)

params.title: ladder name, e.g. 'Unit 7 ladder'
params.from: who sent the dare (a ladder name)
params.when: when it was sent, e.g. '2h ago'
params.ladder: top to bottom, up to 8: {name, cs (time in hundredths, 0 if none), w, l, note}
params.joinAt: rank index where chat members not on the ladder are slotted (0-based)
